title: Mitochondrial respiration measurement
protocol: Isolate mitochondria by gently crushing 40 to 80 flies in a Kontes homogenizer with 7 strokes of the pestle in 3 ml homogenization buffer at 4°C.
Filter the extracts through 8 layers of cheese cloth.
Centrifuge the filtered extract at 300 x G for 3 min.
Centrifuge the supernatant from step 2 at 6000 x G for 10 min to obtain a mitochondrial pellet.
Measure the mitochondrial protein concentration by the Bradford method, corrected for BSA content in the homogenization buffer.
Determine respiration rates by measuring oxygen consumption using a Clark-type electrode and metabolic chamber containing 0.65 ml of reaction buffer at 25°C.
Calculate the mitochondrial ATP production rates from ADP consumption rates during state III respiration.
